body:
## 2026-11-23-viola-open-2 — 8. Cognitive Accessibility: 1 row(s)
**Section:** 8. Cognitive Accessibility
**Change:** ~ contract/cli-refusal/json · promise: was «Under `--json` a refusal gives one document with no hint, except the `viola answer` and `viola send` exit-2 paths, which print a fixed stderr line and no document.»; now «Under `--json` a refusal gives one document with no hint, except the `viola answer`, `viola send` and `viola open` exit-2 paths, which print a fixed stderr line and no document.»
**Why:** contract/cli-refusal/json: viola open's exit-2 program refusal is a fixed line counted among the messages that are no error bodies, so the exception list must name it.
**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-24T00-26-24Z-wrap/

- New event kinds and refusal details are added ONLY here, never with Claude-specific names; `detail` values are kebab-case strings from a closed set per reason (`unknown`'s a code word or null). `EventKind` holds the kinds of `EventKind::ALL` (`budget-gate` is no longer one), the dialog kinds `question` / `permission` / `plan` among them, `link` / `unlink` (`data` keys `driver`, `driven`), `dialog-expired` (`data` keys `dialog_id`, `dialog_kind`; `source: wrapper`, appended once when a held dialog's hold ends) `lineage` (`data` keys `parent`, `role`, each a string or `null`; `source: wrapper`, one line at every start, log-only) `launch` (`data` keys `model`, `effort`, both strings; `source: wrapper`, one line at every start after `lineage`, log-only) and `window` (`data` keys `address`, `workspace`, `placement`, `origin`; `source: wrapper`, one line after `launch` only when started under `--origin`, log-only, never waking `wait`); `EventKind::WAIT_WAKE` is the one wake set (`turn-ended`, `question`, `permission`, `plan`, `session-end`, `dialog-expired`) the wrapper's `wait` and the channel's `outcome` both read.

- CLI exit codes: 0 · 1 (a `cli` verb's internal error: `error: internal error` on stderr, or under `--json` before a `--` the catch site's `{"v":1,"error":"internal-error","detail":null}` on stdout, stderr then empty, `run`, `revive`'s start, `mcp` and `hook` silent at that site; also `viola run`'s and `viola revive`'s start, and `viola verify`, refusing the home tree before any log opens: the home-state `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or the instance-state pair for an instance-level refusal, no line written, no child started; also `viola run` and `viola revive`'s start refusing the socket directory (`socket_dir_ready`, before any snapshot, child or `Server::bind`; a failed create and a refused check read this one code, a `Server::bind` failure does not): the stderr `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or under `viola revive --json` the `socket-dir-refused` document, and one `process-exit{subject:"self", exit_code:1, detail:"socket-dir-refused"}`, no path, pid or uid; `viola verify`'s refusals each carry their code on the `process-exit` it writes under a parsed `VIOLA_NAME`: `program-not-found` · `pinned-hash-mismatch` · `version-unreadable` · `strict-modes-failed` · `unclean-fixture`, beside `interrupted`; a failing row is no refusal and carries no code, yet `viola verify` still exits 1 on a failed relied row with that row's stamp written, and `verify` takes no `--json`; also `viola open`'s refusals, `strict-modes-failed` before any log, `already-live`, `stale-heartbeat`, `pinned-hash-mismatch`, `terminal-not-found`, `not-live` or `internal-error`, each under `--json` the `{"v":1,"error":"<code>","detail":null}` document) · 2 (usage error, and `viola send` text over 16 MiB or not UTF-8) · 10 human-typing · 11 unassigned (the retired `budget-paused` refusal's code, never reused or renumbered) · 12 unverified-cli · 13 not-delivered · 14 unknown · 20 wrapper fault (a `-32602` from `link` / `unlink` included) · 21 instance unreachable (under `--json` `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"<cause>"}`, written by `client::unreachable_document` (the board builds its own), `<cause>` one of the six exit-21 words of `viola_core::UnreachableCause`'s closed seven (the seventh, `call-deadline`, written by the MCP frame tools alone) `strict-modes-failed` · `instance-dead` · `unwrapped-name` · `endpoint-lost` · `server-verify-failed` · `socket-dir-refused`, no `RefusalReason`; with no live endpoint `viola_state::liveness::without_endpoint` reads an instance directory as `instance-dead` and anything else as `unwrapped-name`, so a stale instance reads `instance-dead`, and a wrapper lost with the call open reads `endpoint-lost`; also, on `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` / `pause` / `release` / `link` / `unlink`, a server that is not the recorded wrapper — a connected peer whose euid is not this user's or cannot be read (`peer_admitted`), or the connected peer's pid or OS start time not the snapshot's, or that check not made — no frame written, `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"server-verify-failed"}` under `--json` (Linux only; the Windows and macOS legs left with their code, recoverable at the tag `multi-os-final`), after the client's own exit-13 refusals, the strict-modes instance check and the socket-directory check, with no exit code or `RefusalReason` of its own, its `--json` word the document's `detail`; also `viola list`'s refused strict-modes check of the home, `instances/` or any one instance, which refuses the whole board, no log opened; and `viola plugin install`'s refused strict-modes check of the home or an existing `marketplace/` tree dir, nothing created, no log opened; and the refused instance check of `send` / `wait` / `last` / `answer` / `pause` / `release` (the target instance) and of `viola link` / `viola unlink` (the driven instance), made first by `client::refuse_untrusted` (`check_instance` on the home and `instances/<name>`, after `send`'s text read, before any connect, role file or log opens): the instance-state `unable:` / `hint:` pair, or `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"strict-modes-failed"}` under `--json`, no log opened, no line written; and, on those same eight verbs, past that check and before any connect, a refused socket directory on the recorded endpoint (`check_endpoint_dir` in `client::connect`): the socket-directory hint last on stderr, or `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":"socket-dir-refused"}` under `--json`, one `process-exit` at WARN with `during` `connect` and no `channel-request`); `viola hook` always 0. `viola revive` exits 0, 1 for a refused strict-modes check (ahead of the wrapper log: the stderr pair, no log line) or a preflight refusal (`already-live` or `stale-heartbeat` · `no-session` · `session-live` · `cwd-missing`, read in that order, each one `process-exit` line) or a refusal of the start after a passed preflight, or 2 for a usage error; it takes `--json` on both arms, where a refused strict-modes check and every refusal of its start is instead one stdout document `{"v":1,"error":"<code>","detail":null}` (`strict-modes-failed` · `already-live` · `no-session` · `session-live` · `cwd-missing` · `stale-heartbeat` · `pinned-hash-mismatch` · `squatted-name` · `socket-dir-refused` · `internal-error`, by `client::refused_document`; a `claude` not on `PATH` or an anyhow error of the start is `internal-error`), stderr empty, exit 1, and `<name> --list --json` prints `{"v":1,"ok":{"sessions":[…]}}` in log order (a `pump_child` error prints no document: the child has held the terminal).

- Arguments mirror channel params: `viola send <target>` (text from stdin or `--file`), `viola wait <target> [--after <cursor>] [--timeout-ms <n>]`, `viola last <target>`, `viola answer <target> <dialog_id>` (response JSON from stdin/`--file`), `viola pause <target>`, `viola release <target>` (a `--budget` flag is a usage error, exit 2), `viola link|unlink <driver> <driven>`; `viola open <name> [--parent <name>] [--role overseer|builder|worker] [--cwd <dir>] [--workspace N] [--model M] [--effort E] [--json] -- claude`; `viola revive <name> [--id <ID>] [--fork] [--model <MODEL>] [--effort <EFFORT>] [-- <child args>]` and `viola revive <name> --list` send no channel frame (`--list` conflicts with `--id`, `--fork`, `--model`, `--effort` and the trailing arguments); `viola run --parent <NAME>` declares the instance's parent (one equal to its own name a usage error, exit 2, before anything is read; with no `--parent` an inherited `VIOLA_NAME` is taken as parent only, dropped when it equals the own name) and `viola run --role <WORD>` its role, a code word; `viola run --model <MODEL>` names the model handed to the child, a model word, and `viola run --effort <EFFORT>` its effort, one of the five effort words, a value failing its shape a usage error, exit 2, and with none given each is the `config.json` default, else the compiled default; the hidden `viola run --origin <WORD>` names the window's origin, an origin word (any other word a usage error, exit 2), and the hidden `viola run --place <N>` the workspace the window is moved to (`--place` without `--origin` a usage error, exit 2).

- Readers: over-long lines (> `MAX_FRAME`) count as `torn_lines`; unknown kinds/fields are counted in `skipped`; a reader never writes (the next append heals a torn last line). A snapshot with an unsupported `v` or a parse failure → replay (`state-recovered`) through `replay::read_snapshot_or_replay`, whose five product callers are `viola revive`'s preflight, `viola list`'s `board::read`, `liveness::live_endpoint`, `viola hook`'s `connect` (a replayed or absent snapshot unreachable, so the hook fails open) and `run`'s collision check (a replayed snapshot judged by the heartbeat alone); the replay writes no file, rebuilds `lineage` from the log (the last `lineage` line replacing the held value) and `launch` (`{model, effort}`, the last `launch` line replacing the held value, a line with a non-string member reading none) and `window` (`{address?, workspace?, placement, origin}`, the last `window` line after the last `launch` line winning and a later `launch` line clearing it) and recovers `links` from the logged `link` / `unlink` lines through the public rule `replay::apply_link_line` (a pair keeps its first `since` until an `unlink`; a `link` line with no string `ts` reads `since: "unknown"`), which the root bin's `LinkSet` applies as well.

| CLI parser | clap 4.6.7 (derive; `default-features = false`, its default set minus `color` (`Cargo.toml`), so help and usage output is plain and no colour/terminal crate is in the graph) | Subcommands `run · revive · open · send · wait · last · list · answer · hook · mcp · verify · pause · release · link · unlink · plugin install` |

Entry 28 (R2), fired ONCE at 2026-11-24T00:07:17Z: `28 e2e         red · exit 0 ✗ (exit 1) · exit 1 · 0.42s · 93 B → 28.log · history: unmoved`. Its verdict line, copied from 28.log:

A red is final: no second start, no retry of any part. The open never ran, so the ONE claude start was not spent (no claude process started: the child instance was never made).

## The cause, as measured (the first scratch home's own records, kept as the red's record)
- The parent wrapper started (`run-parent.ndjson` 00:07:17.767Z), its version probe of `/usr/bin/sleep --version`
  exited 0, its window step read `clients` twice and placed its own window: the parent's `window` line and snapshot
  read `{workspace:1, placement:"placed", origin:"cli"}` (a real foot window viola opened, moved by the one move
  dispatch).
- Its child, `/usr/bin/sleep`, spawned at 00:07:17.920Z (`claude-child` start, child pid recorded), exited 1 at
  00:07:17.941Z — 21 ms — and the wrapper ended exit 0, so its foot closed and the script read `parent-not-live`.
- The refused arguments: the wrapper hands every child `--plugin-dir <plugin dir>`, then `--model <m> --effort <e>`
  (the launch pair, here `opus` / `medium`), ahead of the program's own words (`child_launch`, `src/run/mod.rs`;
  `PLUGIN_DIR_FLAG` and `launch_args`, `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/lib.rs`). `sleep` refuses `--plugin-dir`.
  The rig's defect, not `viola open`'s: the plan named `/usr/bin/sleep 900` as the parent's program.
- The inherited name: the script ran with this builder session's `VIOLA_NAME` (`viola-builder`), `VIOLA_DIR` and
  `VIOLA_BIN`; the parent's `lineage` line reads `parent: "viola-builder"`, and the board's `viola list` wrote
  `diagnostics/cli-viola-builder.ndjson` into the scratch home.
- A further finding: `claude` resolves on PATH (`~/.local/share/mise/command-wrappers/bin/claude`), so the script's
  two `viola list` reads each spawned the host's own `claude agents --json` (the `agents-probe` pairs in
  `cli-viola-builder.ndjson`) — a read over the operator's real sessions through his real config. The board went
  into a script variable only (never printed or written), but «nothing of the real `~/.claude*` is read» was not held
  by it.

## The mend (`scripts/r2-open.sh`, the overseer's relay `inputs#I8`)
- The parent's program is a stand-in the script writes itself, `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola-r2/work/parent-stand-in`
  (0700, `/bin/sh`): `--version` alone (the version probe's one argument) prints one line and exits 0; any other
  argv — the wrapper's `--plugin-dir <dir> --model <m> --effort <e>` — is ignored, and it `exec`s `/usr/bin/sleep 900`.
- Every exported `VIOLA_*` name is unset from the script's own environment first (`compgen -e`), so no command it
  starts inherits one. The other inherited names the wrapper or the open read, the code's own list:
  `VIOLA_NAME` / `VIOLA_DIR` (`client::own_name`, `resolve_home` — now absent), `PATH` (program resolution),
  `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` (the socket directory), `HOME` (`std::env::home_dir` — the user home, the trust record's config),
  `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` (only when `claude_env_keep` keeps it; set by the script on the open alone), the colour facts
  `NO_COLOR` / `TERM` / `COLORTERM` (`list`'s human mode only — the script reads `--json`), and every name's NAME
  (never a value) for the R8 strip, whose `CLAUDE*` names are taken out of the child's environment. None of them
  names the session that fires the script; no `VIOLA_*` name is left.
- Every `viola list` the script makes runs with `PATH` set to an empty dir (`work/no-claude`): the board's
  `claude agents --json` read finds no claude and spawns none.
- `--rehearse`: everything up to «the parent is live» and the read of its window (placement from its own snapshot,
  address from the board, workspace from `clients`), then `r2-rehearsal: <green|red> parent_placement=<word>
  parent_workspace=<n|none>[ first=<reading>][ left=<n>]` and the same cleanup. By construction it never reaches
  the open: the open stands only in the `else` branch of the one `if [ -n "$rehearse" ]`, whose rehearsal branch
  ends in `finish`, which exits.

## The rehearsal — ONCE, the parent alone, no open, no claude
- `hyprctl locked` at 2026-11-24T00:10:22Z: `true`.
- The second scratch home `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola-r2/rehearse-home` (0700), its `config.json` (0600) byte-equal to
  the first's; the first home untouched.
- `bash scripts/r2-open.sh --rehearse "$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/viola-r2/rehearse-home" target/debug/viola` at
  2026-11-24T00:10:26Z, exit 0:

r2-rehearsal: green parent_placement=placed parent_workspace=1

- After it: its parent's `lineage` line reads `parent: null`; its `diagnostics/` holds `run-parent.ndjson` alone (no
  `cli-*` log); `clients` lists 0 windows of app-id `viola.parent` or `viola.child`; `gate.py census --args
  viola-r2/rehearse-home --args parent-stand-in --args viola.parent` → `census: none running`.

## Where R2 stands
The one capped claude start is UNSPENT. R2 is not fired again in this run; whether it fires once more is the
